The '''Cavamina system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas" /> It contained the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Cavamina Minor]].<ref name="Deadly Hands" />
